description: One newly authored complete single-station screen-printing-press appearance in a fixed raised-frame pose. Two rear hinge roots and a common axle carry two real clamp-body appearances and one continuous rectangular raised screen frame. The rear hinge/forward empty platen/raised open-mesh relationship is new, not the old vertical chase and lever platen press or rotary duplicator repurposed. No prior press mesh imported; no squeegee, ink, garment or artwork included. One complete prop, zero scenes, four opaque constant PBR materials, metres Z up and whole horizontal ground datum. Static workshop appearance only: no stencil, ink transfer, mesh tension, hinge sweep, clamping, registration, manufacturing, installation, capacity or machinery safety claim.
